name: desk-mobile
description: Nightshift mobile shell (Capacitor): connects to a Nightshift hub on your LAN and shows its web UI.

scripts.add:android: npm run sync:www && cap add android
scripts.add:ios: npm run sync:www && cap add ios
scripts.build:android:debug: npm run sync:www && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:android:release: npm run sync:www && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
